title_en: Effects of using an English digital textbook and a translator on EFL students’ writing skills and learning attitudes

abstract_ko: This study intended to investigate the use of an English digital textbook and a machine translator on 6th graders’ writing skills and their attitudes toward self-regulated learning. The participants were twenty 6th grade EFL learners who went through the experimental lessons where they implemented writing activities from the digital textbook and referred to the translator before they completed the writing tasks. A controlled group of 20 students went through the paper textbook-based lessons. Data were collected for 12 weeks, and they include pre- and post-writing tests, writing tasks, questionnaires, and the teacher and the researcher’s observation records. The results of data analysis showed significant differences between the two groups in their writing abilities. Significant differences were also found between the first and second writing tasks that the participants completed before and after using the tools in each lesson. Regarding learning attitudes, intrinsic motivation and using learning strategies showed significant improvement. It was found that the majority of the participants wanted to keep using the digital textbook in English classes whereas only about a half of them did so for using the translator. Limitations of the study and suggestions for further study were also discussed based on the results.

abstract_ko: 목적 본 연구는 영어 디지털 교과서에서는 제공하지 않는 상호작용 기술을 가진 AI 챗봇을 도입한 수업을 하며 초등학교 학생들의영어 자신감 및 의사소통의지(WTC)의 변화, AI 활용 영어 학습이 학습자의 인식에 미치는 영향을 살펴보는 데에 그 목적이 있다. 방법 연구 대상은 초등학교에 재학 중인 4학년 학생들이며 2020년 10월~11월, 총 8회에 걸쳐 AI 챗봇을 활용하여 수업을 한 후자신감 및 WTC 설문지, 사후 설문지를 수집하여 분석하였다. WTC 및 자신감은 구조화된 설문지를 바탕으로 결과를 분석하였고, AI 활용 영어 학습이 학습자의 인식에 미치는 영향은 사후 설문지를 통해 분석하였다. 결과 본 연구 결과 AI 챗봇을 활용한 영어 수업이 초등학생의 영어 자신감 및 의사소통의지(WTC)의 향상에 도움을 주었다. 또한사후 설문에서 AI 챗봇을 활용한 수업에 긍정적인 답변 및 지속적인 이용을 희망하는 학생들이 많았다. 결론 이러한 연구 결과는 영어 디지털 교과서에 AI 챗봇을 활용한 영어 수업의 확산으로 학습자의 영어 학습에 긍정적인 영향을끼치는 초석이 될 수 있을 것이다.

title_en: Promise and Challenges of AI based English Digital Textbooks in Elementary Schools
kw_ko: 영어 AI 디지털교과서; 초등학교; 다양한 쟁점; 2022학년 개정 교육과정; 신체적 및 인지적 특성

abstract_ko: This study investigated the impact of learning using elementary school English digital textbooks and learning tools integrated with AI and students’, teachers’, and parents’ perceptions of them based on existing studies. It also discussed the issues and challenges surrounding associated with AI learning tools in a fully integrated AI classroom. The use of digital textbooks and AI-enabled learning tools has shown some positive effects on English learning for elementary students. However, when AI based English digital textbooks are introduced in elementary schools, it is proposed that there may be eight issues in the paper, including over-reliance on AI and voice recognition software despite their inaccuracies, changes in teacher roles, problems with the physical and mental aspects of elementary school students, challenges in the learning side, issues in the use of various digital devices, rapid development schedules and huge development and hardware costs, personal information and security concerns. Given these issues, it is recommended that, when introducing AI digital textbooks into elementary schools under the 2022 National Revised Curriculum, careful attention should be given to the effective utilization of AI-based English textbooks and the integration of traditional print textbooks with AI-driven resources. This should be done while taking into account the physical and cognitive traits of elementary school students as well as strengths and weaknesses associated with rapidly evolving AI technology.

title_en: Challenges and considerations in adopting AI digital textbook for middle school English
kw_ko: 디지털교과서; 서책형교과서; 중학교 영어교과서; AI 디지털교과서; 교육정책

abstract_ko: The Korean Ministry of Education has recently undertaken a notable initiative to integrate AI digital textbooks into its educational reform strategies. This development, while promising, has also raised anticipation and concern, reminiscent of the mixed responses and challenges that accompanied the initial introduction of digital textbooks in the mid-2000s. The aim of this study is to scrutinize the lessons derived from the preliminary use of digital textbooks in junior secondary English classrooms, offering vital considerations for the successful implementation and practice of AI digital textbooks. Employing a critical literature review as the research method, this study systematically evaluates and interprets extant research on digital English textbooks’ utilization among junior high school students and teachers in the Korean EFL context. The findings reveal that the mere creation of AI-enhanced English textbooks is not a guarantee of success. Instead, the effectiveness of these tools largely depends on English teachers’ capabilities to adeptly navigate and utilize the rich functionalities and analytical prowess provided by these advanced platforms. Furthermore, the educators’ skill in pedagogically integrating these AI resources is paramount. The study also emphasizes the necessity for the AI digital textbooks’ design and development process, as well as teacher training initiatives, to comprehensively incorporate the cognitive, emotional, and physiological characteristics of early to mid-adolescent learners. As an implication, the study posits that the Ministry of Education’s ability to capitalize fully on the AI digital textbook initiative requires the enthusiastic involvement and input of all key educational stakeholders, including both educators and students. title_ko: 챗봇과 생성형 AI 활용 영어교육
title_en: AI-powered English Education with Chatbots and Generative AIs.
kw_ko: AI 활용 영어교육; 챗봇; 생성형 AI; AI 디지털교과서; 특수 목적 영어
kw_en: AI-powered English education; chatbot; generative chatbot; generative AI; AI digital textbook; ESP
abstract_ko: With the commercialization of generative AI, the development of AI digital textbooks is progressing rapidly in the context of the EdTech industry. AI digital textbooks, based on the Revised 2022 National Curriculum, adopt a cloud-based approach and presuppose the use of generative AI, leading to significant changes in English education. The emergence of generative chatbots, in particular, gives the impression that research on AI chatbot-assisted English education is not keeping up with the times. However, upon closer examination of the strengths and weaknesses of rule-based chatbots, AI chatbots, and generative chatbots, it becomes apparent that there must be a division of labor in applying them to English education. Rule-based chatbots can be used in areas where high accuracy is required, AI chatbots can be used where meaningful practices are employed, and generative chatbots can be used for communicative practices. Furthermore, generative AI shows high potential for creating and transforming learning materials suitable for learners’ levels, as well as for the direct assessment of speaking and writing. By differentiating between the roles of AI digital textbooks and teachers, a more effective English education can be performed, and this can be applied to diverse ESP education areas, offering a customized learning experience.

title_en: Developing classroom-friendly teaching models for elementary English AI digital textbooks

abstract_ko: This study investigates the development of effective, classroom-friendly teaching models for the implementation of AI digital textbooks in elementary English education in South Korea. By synthesizing the latest theoretical frameworks and research findings, the goal of this study is to offer practical insights and recommendations for elementary-level English teachers. The primary focus is on the integration of AI digital textbooks into classroom settings to enhance both the teaching and learning experience. Among the key areas of exploration are the pedagogical advantages of AI-driven content, strategies to address potential implementation challenges, and best practices for maximizing student engagement and achievement. The findings of this study are intended to guide educators so that they may create robust, adaptable, and effective English teaching models that are tailored to the unique dynamics of elementary school environments.

title_en: The basics of AIDT-powered English education
kw_ko: AI 디지털교과서/AIDT 활용 영어교육/챗봇
kw_en: AI digital textbook(AIDT)/AIDT powered English education/Chatbot
abstract_ko: In the current situation, where expectations and concerns coexist regarding the introduction of AI digital textbooks, the results of a survey on perceptions of AI digital textbooks reveal both positive and negative aspects. However, concerns may be alleviated when considering research findings that show chatbot-assisted English education, such as using AI-based tools like AI PengTalk, is effective for learning and significantly improves affective factors. In addition, it is necessary to address apprehensions and concerns in educational settings by providing practical training on the key features of AI digital textbooks as well as teaching, learning, and assessment models. It is also important to notice that AI digital textbooks are useful tools that support various learning styles, provide personalized learning experiences for students, offer real-time feedback, automate assessments, and assist teachers in delivering their curricula. After reviewing two types of models for teaching, learning, and assessment using AI digital textbooks(traditional teaching-learning models and assessment-centered teaching-learning models), this paper proposed a list of learning activities utilizing AI digital textbook functions for the use of AI digital textbooks in English education. Additionally, it suggested a feature-selective AI digital textbook teaching-learning model, enabling selective use of features and functions during preview, classroom instruction, or review.

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 2025학년도 초등영어 AI 디지털교과서 도입에 따른 학생들의 읽기 학습 진단 및 맞춤형학습 방안을 탐색하였다. AI 디지털교과서는 이전의 디지털교과서와 마찬가지로 각종 멀티미디어 자료와 그림 사전 등을 포함하고 있지만, 클라우드 방식의 인공지능형 학습 플랫폼으로 개발되어 학생들의 읽기 학습 과정과 결과를 다각적으로 분석ㆍ진단한 결과를 제공하고, 이에 따른 맞춤형 읽기 학습을 제공할 것으로 기대된다. 먼저 읽기 학습의 진단 방안을 탐색하고자, 본 연구는 기존에 개발된교육과정 표준체계의 내용 요소와 읽기 진단 선행 연구의 영역을 비교하였으며, 이들 내용 요소는 학습자의 읽기 능력을 진단하는 데 대체로 적절한 것으로 분석되었다. 다만 개별 학습자의 성취 수준이나 발달 단계를 세밀하게 포착하기 위해 내용 요소 간의 위계 및 연계를 보여주는 학습맵을 좀 더 세분화할 필요가 있었다. 그리고 세분화된 내용 요소와 연계된 문항 데이터베이스 구축이 필요하며, 음성 인식 엔진 등의 기능을 활용한 다양한 평가 방법이 필요한 것으로 파악되었다. 아울러 데이터 마이닝을 활용한 학습분석학 연구를 참고하여 학습자들의 읽기 패턴이나 수행 양상, 참여 정도를 다각적으로 수집하여 분석할 것을 제안하였다. 맞춤형 읽기 학습과 관련하여, 미국 사례와 우리나라 교육과정에 대한 비교 분석을 바탕으로 알파벳 체계, 유창성, 이해의 영역별, 난이도별 학습 콘텐츠 개발이필요함을 제안하였으며, 이를 위해 기존에 개발된 학습 콘텐츠의 분류 및 활용 방안을 탐색하였다. 그리고 학습자 특성에 기반한 코스웨어 설계 방안으로서, 그림과 텍스트 배치, 단일 화면 텍스트의 길이및 구성, TTS 기능의 적정한 활용 방안을 살펴보았다. 마지막으로 AI 디지털교과서의 발전 및 활용도를 높이기 위한 후속 연구 방향을 제시하였다.

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 2025년 도입 예정인 2022 개정 교육과정 초등학교 영어과 AI 디지털교과서 7종(3-4학년 대상)을 분석하여 교육과정 부합성, 학습 지원, 교사 지원, 기술적 측면을 평가하였다. 분석 결과, AI 디지털교과서들은 2022 개정 교육과정의 목표를 대체로 반영하고 있으나, 표현 영역과 상호작용적 교수 활동의 디지털 환경 구현은 미흡한 것으로 나타났다. AI 기반 평가와 개별화된 피드백 시스템은 우수했지만, 자기 주도적 학습 경로 설정과 멀티미디어 도구 활용은 제한적이었다. 교사 지원 기능은 기본적으로 잘 구현되었으나, 교과서 간 교수학습 자료의 품질과 다양성에 차이가 있었다. 기술적 측면에서는 기기 호환성은 확보되었으나, 사용자 인터페이스의 직관성과 특수교육 대상자 지원은 미흡했다. 분석을 통해 AI 디지털교과서의 지속적인 개선과 발전을 위한 과제를 제시하였다.

abstract_ko: To prepare for digital transformation and the era of AI, Korea’s Ministry of Education announced the implementation of AI digital textbooks in English, mathematics, and computer science in elementary and secondary schools starting in 2025. AIDT aims at personalized/customized learning through AI-based learning analytics. AIDT can be an effective alternative tool to provide personalized/ customized learning in addition to traditional English classrooms. However, in the first year of implementation, models for effectively integrating AIDT into the classroom are still rare. Since instructional approaches and models are crucial for successful implementation and student learning, the purpose of this study is to present effective instructional models using AIDT. As a research method, the study analyzed the characteristics and specifics of AIDT and then applied them to the teaching models based on the characteristics of AIDT and the communicative language teaching approach. This study presents three models, task-based, project-based and problem-based language teaching, which English teachers can use in their teaching with AIDT. The models can be used as guidelines for teachers to integrate AIDT into their classrooms.

abstract_ko: 목적 본 연구는 2014년부터 2024년 기간 국내 논문, 국외 논문 및 국내 웹 뉴스 자료에 대한 텍스트 마이닝과 키워드 빈도수 분석을통한 언어 네트워크 분석을 통해 2025년 3월부터 도입된 AI 기반 영어 교과서(AIDT)가 영어 교육에 미치는 기대와 우려 세밀하게분석하였다. 방법 본 연구는 텍스트 마이닝과 언어 네트워크 분석을 활용하여 AI 기반 영어 교과서 도입과 관련된 주요 키워드를 도출하고, 이에대한 언어 네트워크 분석을 수행하였다. 주로 언급되는 경향을 분석하기 위해 국내 논문 163편, 국외 논문 210편, 그리고 국내 웹뉴스 데이터 20,981개를 수집 및 분석하였고 TEXTOM 및 Netminer 4.5 프로그램이 이용되었다. 결과 '학습', '교사', '데이터', '윤리적 문제', '비용'이 키워드 네트워크 분석의 결과 주요 키워드로 분석되었다. 국내에서는 AI를 사용한영어 학습이 학생에게 맞는 학습 경험 제공하고 이를 통한 성취도 향상을 기대할 수 있다고 주장하였다. 아울러 교사의 역할 변화와교육 환경 개선에 대한 기대도 언급하였다. 그러나 AI 기술에 과도하게 의존할 때 교사의 수동적 역할이 우려되고, AI 학습 도구의 개인정보 침해 및 정보 편향으로 인한 문제를 언급한다. 국외 연구에서는 AI가 효율적이고 객관적인 학습 평가를 가능하게 할 것이라 기대한다. 다만, 교사의 역량 강화와 사용자의 사생활 침해와 같은 윤리적 문제를 해결해야 함을 주장한다. 국내 웹 뉴스 분석에서는 AI를 활용한 영어 교육이 효율적이며 맞춤식 교육이 가능할 것이라는 기대가 있지만, 도입 초기의 경제적 부담에 대한 우려가 분석되었다. 결론 AIDT를 이용한 영어 학습의 기대와 우려를 종합적으로 제시한 본 연구를 통해 향후 영어 AIDT의 활용의 더 나은 방향에 대한대화의 토대가 마련되길 기대한다.

abstract_ko: This study aims to provide foundational data for developing perception-based training materials for pre-service teachers during the early implementation phase of AI Digital Textbooks (AIDT) in English education. A survey was conducted with 24 pre-service secondary English teachers to examine their perceptions of AI-based digital technology, AIDT evaluation criteria, and the educational effectiveness of AIDT. The results indicated that participants prioritized ethical use and social responsibility regarding AI technology. Among AIDT evaluation criteria, fairness, linguistic accuracy, and personalized learning support were rated as the most important. In terms of perceived educational benefits, AIDT was viewed as most effective in improving listening, viewing, and vocabulary skills, while writing and presenting skills received lower ratings. Correlation analysis revealed a significant relationship between participants‘ self-assessed English proficiency and their perceptions of AI application in teaching, particularly for speaking and viewing. However, no significant correlation was found between English proficiency and perceptions of AIDT evaluation criteria. Qualitative responses highlighted both optimism about personalized learning and concerns about learner health, attention, and classroom management. These findings suggest that pre-service teacher education should include differentiated, practice-based AIDT training, emphasize ethical and sustainable use, and offer tailored support based on teachers' language proficiency levels.

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 초등교사의 영어 AI 디지털교과서(AIDT)에 대한 인식과 연수 요구를 탐색하고자 하였다. 이를 위해 다양한 지역의 초등교사 66명을 대상으로 설문조사를 실시하였고, 교사 9명을 대상으로 서면 면담을 실시하였다. 수집된 자료는 빈도분석 및 주제분석을 중심으로 양적, 질적 분석을 활용한 혼합분석방법으로 분석하였다. 주요 연구 결과는 다음과 같다: 첫째, 실시간 발음 평가 및 피드백 제공, 학생 맞춤형 학습 경로 제공, 게임화 요소를 활용한 학습 참여 유도 등에서 AIDT가 유용한 것으로 보았다. 향후 영어 AIDT를 수업에 실제 적용 계획에 대해서도 대체적으로 긍정적이었다. AIDT가 학습자 참여를 촉진시키는데 도움이 된다고 보았다. 영어 AIDT 연수가 대체적으로 영어 교수에 유용하다고 보았다. 영어 AIDT에 대한 기대(학생들의 학습 흥미와 동기 유발, 학생 맞춤형 학습 지원, AI 기반 영어 평가 및 피드백 제공 등)와 우려(기기 및 네트워크 환경 문제, 교사의 활용 역량 부족, 학생 간 학습 격차 심화, 콘텐츠 신뢰성 부족)를 나타내었다. 둘째, 교사들은 이론 중심의 연수보다 실습 위주의 실제 기반 연수, 그리고 대면과 온라인을 병행하는 혼합형을 선호하였다. 연수 참여 여건과 접근성이 개선되기를 바라고 있었다. 다양한 형태의 연수 기회 확대, 교사학습공동체와 연계 운영, 우수 사례 시스템 구축 등의 정책 및 지원이 있기를 바랬다. 셋째, 교직 및 영어 교수 경력에 따라 인식과 요구가 유사하면서도 다른 점이 있었다. 고경력 교사들은 기술의 교육적 활용 가능성과 한계를 신중하게 고려하는 한편, 저경력 교사는 새로운 수업 도구에 대한 흥미와 수용 태도가 높았다. 교육연수에서 고경력 교사들은 자료 수정 및 보완, 학습자 맞춤형 기능의 실제적용 등에 관심이 있는 반면, 저경력 교사들은 AIDT 활용법과 구체적인 사례를 알고 싶어 하였다. 연수 경험 유무에 따라 상이하였는데, 연수 경험이 있는 교사들은 도구의 기능뿐 아니라 수업 맥락에 맞는 활용 방식을 스스로 구상하거나 이미 실천하고 있었으며, 연수 미경험자는 도구 자체에 대한 이해 부족과 적용 거리감을 나타냈다. AIDT 관련 연수 기회 및 참여 가능성, 그리고 AIDT에 관한 정보 접근성이 근무 지역 및 환경에 따라 차이가 나타나기도 하였다. 넷째, AIDT의 실제 수업 적용시 어려운 점은 교실 상황에 맞지 않는 콘텐츠, 학생 수준과의 괴리, 기기 및 네트워크 환경의 불안정성, 기능 숙지 어려움, 학습 흐름 단절 우려, 수업 시간 내 활용 분량 조절의 어려움 등으로 나타났다. 영어 AIDT의 안정적 수업 적용을 위해 초등교사들이 제시한 개선 요구는 AIDT 활용에 적합한 수업시간 확보, 실제 수업 중심의 실습형 연수 확대, 교사 간 공동수업 및 협업체제 구축, 업무 경감을 위한 행정 지원, 학교 관리자 및 동료교사의 협조 강화, 정기적인 후속 연수 및 컨설팅 등으로 나타났다. 본 연구는 초등영어 AIDT의 적용과 개선, AIDT의 적용을 위한 교사교육 및 전문성 신장에 대한 필요성과 시사점을 던져주고 있다.

abstract_ko: This study explores pre-service elementary teachers’ perceptions of using English AI digitaltextbooks (AIDT) in primary schools. To this end, a survey was conducted among 78 pre-serviceelementary teachers enrolled on an English materials development course in the spring semesterof 2025. The findings of the study were as follows. First, pre-service elementary teachers, like inservice teachers, acknowledged the positive features of AIDT, such as personalized learning andreal-time feedback. However, they also expressed concerns about disparities in learning outcomesresulting from varying levels of digital competency and difficulties in managing digital devices. Second, over 80% of participants rated their own digital and AI competencies positively. Regarding digital textbooks, 69% indicated that specialized training for their use is necessary. Onlya small number of pre-service teachers expressed a desire to use AIDT as a replacement fortraditional textbooks, while the vast majority preferred utilizing it as a supplementary resource. Third, in their descriptive responses, pre-service teachers expressed concern that using AIDT asthe primary textbook could reduce interactions between teachers and students, as well as amongstudents themselves. Based on these results, suggestions for future research and education areprovided.

abstract_ko: This study aimed to analyze elementary school teachers’ needs regarding the functions of AI-based digital English textbooks. Data were collected from a survey of 96 elementary school teachers. First, a paired sample t-test was first used to examine differences between perceived importance and current implementation. Borich’s needs assessment model was then applied to identify priority items, and the Locus for Focus model was followed visualize them. Finally, a comprehensive analysis was conducted to determine the most urgent needs. Results showed that among five categories— Diagnostic and Evaluation Functions, Support for Personalized Instructional Design, Adaptive Learning Support, AI Tutor and Assistant Teacher, and Dashboard and User Interface—the highest need was in Diagnostic and Evaluation Functions. Personalized Instructional Design and Adaptive Learning Support also showed high demand. These findings suggest that AI-based digital textbooks remain in a developmental phase, requiring further discussion on how to implement them effectively according to subjectspecific needs.

abstract_ko: This study explores middle school English teachers’ experiences and perceptions of using AI digital textbooks (AIDT) during the first semester of 2025. Employing a mixed-methods approach, the research conducted surveys and in-depth interviews with eight teachers who actively used AIDT in their classes across diverse regional contexts including Seoul, Gyeonggi, Daegu, and Jeonnam. Data were analyzed through content analysis and thematic analysis to examine classroom changes, core function utilization, effectiveness across language skills, and implementation challenges. The findings reveal that AIDT enhanced student participation and individualized learning, particularly benefiting underachieving students. Additionally, AIDT led to diverse teacher role identities including instructional designers, facilitators, and managers. Among core functions, teacher customization received the highest evaluation, whereas AI tutor functions were rated least favorably. Regarding language skills, speaking activities demonstrated the highest perceived effectiveness, while reading showed little advantage over traditional textbooks. Implementation challenges identified by teachers encompassed technical infrastructure limitations, complex administrative procedures, rushed policy rollout, teacher-related factors, and significant quality disparities among publishers. The study concludes that while AIDT holds promise for enhancing personalized learning and student engagement, addressing the identified challenges is essential to realizing its full potential in diverse educational contexts. title_en: High School Students' Perceptions of English AI Digital Textbooks: A Comparison Based on English Learning Achievement
kw_en: AI digital textbook; English learning; perception; achievement level; self-directed learning; emotional stability
abstract_ko: As artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly transforms education, the AI Digital Textbook (AIDT) has emerged as a key innovation for personalized and interactive learning. This study examined high school students’ perceptions of using the English AIDT according to their English achievement levels. A total of 149 first-year high school students who had used the AIDT in English classes participated in the study. Data were collected through surveys and open-ended responses from students, as well as in-depth interviews with both students and teachers. The survey measured four categories (i.e., self-directed learning, level-based learning, functional aspects, and emotional stability). The findings showed that students generally held positive perceptions of the AIDT, particularly regarding its functional convenience and feedback system. However, self-directed learning received the lowest mean score, revealing that autonomy and self-regulated learning strategies have not yet been fully developed within the AIDT environment. The statistical results indicated that students showed significantly different perceptions across the four categories with self-directed learning scoring significantly lower than the other three categories. When comparing the two groups by achievement level, higher-achieving students generally showed more positive perceptions. However, significant differences were found only in emotional stability, suggesting that immediate feedback may enhance motivation for higher achievers but cause anxiety for lower achievers. Overall, while the AIDT supports personalized and interactive learning, its effective use also depends on instructional guidance that fosters learner autonomy and provides emotional support for students at different achievement levels.

abstract_ko: The study aims to examine the perceptions of elementary school teachers regarding the use of English AIDT. A questionnaire consisting of ten open-ended questions was used with ten elementary school teachers who had experience using English AIDT in classes or through teacher training programs. The results showed that most participants expressed positive views on the change in legal status of AIDT from textbooks to educational materials. It was also found that as positive aspects of using English AIDT, participants mentioned the customized learning tailored to students' levels and the individual feedback function, and as negative aspects, they pointed out the increased burden on teachers and the reduced opportunities of interactions with teachers and peers. Lastly, participants proposed teacher training programs on the use of AIDT and digital literacy education for students for the efficient use of English AIDT.

abstract_ko: The Ministry of Education in Korea has officially approved the implementation of the Artificial Intelligence Digital Textbook (AIDT) in schools, which integrates adaptive learning and automated evaluation systems. This study examines the usefulness of the AI feedback system within AIDT from the perspective of English teachers. The AIDT’s AI feedback system aims to support teachers’ assessment practices by providing individualized feedback for students with developing writing skills. However, how the system influences teachers’ assessment practices remains unclear. This study investigated the experiences of four Korean middle school English teachers using the AI feedback system and identified the affordances and constraints that emerged during use. Teachers assessed sample student essays using the system; their online assessment sessions were recorded and followed by in-depth interviews. The findings indicate that, although the system offered technological advantages and instructional support, issues related to feedback inaccuracy and limited customization prompted teachers to engage in additional review and modification of the automated feedback. Based on these experiences, teachers suggested practical improvements to enhance the feedback quality and system usability. This study offers insights into how teachers incorporate AI feedback into classroom assessment and proposes directions for refining the AI feedback system.

title_en: Trends, Research Issues and Applications of AI-based Primary English Education

abstract_ko: This study conducts a narrative review of domestic empirical literature of the past decade to explore the current state and future directions of AIEE for primary learners. Utilizing a multi-dimensional coding framework, the research analyzes 103 studies in terms of general research, educational, and implicational contexts. The findings reveal a chronological evolution categorized into three phases ranging from early inception to recent accelerated growth driven by generative technologies and digital policies. Methodologically, the result demonstrates a strong preference for mixed methods and quantitative approaches, focusing on verifying educational impacts and efficacy. Regarding educational context, AI applications have predominantly focused on productive skills, particularly speaking and writing, while consistently yielding significant positive impacts on the affective domain by reducing anxiety and increasing learners' willingness to communicate. The study further highlights a transition toward blended and flipped learning models that integrate commercial platforms and recent generative AI tools. Consequently, we demonstrate through our results underscore the impending normalization of AI-assisted language learning(AIALL), necessitating a paradigm shift in the teacher’s role from a primary linguistic source to a facilitator and coach.

title_ko: Improving L2 Writing Through Artificial Intelligence: Comparing AIDT and ChatGPT Feedback
title_en: Improving L2 Writing Through Artificial Intelligence: Comparing AIDT and ChatGPT Feedback
kw_en: Artificial Intelligence; automated written feedback; L2 writing; AIDT; ChatGPT; feedback; middle school
abstract_ko: This study examines two AI-driven written feedback tools—ChatGPT and AI Digital Textbooks (AIDT)—by comparing their effects on Korean middle school students’ English writing performance and perceptions. Over six weeks, fifty seventh graders completed six expository writing tasks and received feedback from either ChatGPT or AIDT. Pre- and post-tests and questionnaires assessed changes in writing performance and affective factors, including motivation, self-efficacy, metacognition, and anxiety. Results showed significant improvement in both groups with large effect sizes, although overall post-test scores did not differ. Subcomponent analyses revealed that ChatGPT better supported content and idea development, while AIDT was stronger in grammar and cohesion. ChatGPT users also reported higher motivation, self-efficacy, and perceived usefulness. Overall, both tools supported L2 writing, but with distinct pedagogical strengths: AIDT promoted accuracy through structured, rule-based feedback, whereas ChatGPT provided adaptive, dialogic feedback encouraging higher-order thinking. These findings suggest that tool selection should align with learners’ proficiency levels and instructional goals across different stages of writing.

abstract_ko: This study explores how two Korean female English teachers integrated an AI Digital Textbook (AIDT) into their Grade 4 classrooms in South Korea. One teacher used AIDT for a semester, while the other implemented it over a year. Data were gathered through semi-structured individual interviews with the teachers, along with lesson plans, school reports, parent surveys, and photographs of classroom activities. These diverse sources were triangulated and member-checked to enhance validity. Content analysis was used to interpret the data. The teachers employed different strategies with AIDT, which shaped both the challenges and benefits they experienced. Initially, students faced technical difficulties logging in, which increased the teachers’ emotional workload. Additionally, some students felt anxious due to ‘negative’ automated feedback emphasizing accuracy in speaking, leading to reluctance in participating in speaking activities. Ironically, while AIDT offered individualized learning experiences and automated assessment, it also diminished human interaction between teachers and students. Based on these findings, the study recommends that teachers actively mediate and reinterpret AIDT feedback and advocates for redesigning AIDT to better promote collaborative language use. Ultimately, the study highlights the importance of incorporating English teachers’ experiences and insights into the development of AIDT.

abstract_ko: This study investigates how generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) and AI-based digital textbooks (AIDT) influence English teachers’ teaching motivation and demotivation, as well as their instructional experiences and professional identity perceptions, in the Korean public education context. A qualitative approach was employed, drawing on semi-structured interviews with teachers across different school levels to capture their lived experiences of AI integration in classroom. Findings reveal that AI enhanced teaching motivation by reducing classroom anxiety, fostering confidence, and creating opportunities for innovative lesson design. Teachers emphasized that adapting texts, incorporating real-world issues, and personalizing materials for diverse learners increased both professional identity and student-teacher engagement. Such experiences reflect the fulfillment of competence and relatedness needs. Moreover, the use of AI expanded teachers’ sense of instructional efficacy, while also generating new challenges such as device management, technical setup, and the need of establishing assessment rubric for students’ assignment assisted by AI tools. The findings also highlighted that teachers redefined their roles from English-language knowledge transmitters to learning facilitators and advisors, though concerns about professional deskilling and identity crisis persisted. Overall, AI served double-edged functions simultaneously destabilizing and re-establishing teachers’ teaching motivation, instructional experiences, and professional identity perceptions.

abstract_ko: As AI digital textbooks (AIDT) are increasingly adopted in K-12 education, systematic research on their actual classroom implementation and student reception remains scarce. This study investigates classroom use of English AIDT, students’ perceptions of educational value and technology acceptance, and associated learning needs. A total of 653 first-year middle school students from four schools responded to a survey. Results revealed that classroom use of AIDT was generally limited and varied across schools. Among AIDT’s five core functions, learning analytics and assignments were used more frequently, whereas AI tutor was less utilized. Despite limited use, students reported largely positive perceptions of AIDT’s educational value and technology acceptance. Higher levels of classroom AIDT use and English proficiency were associated with more positive perceptions. Analysis of learner needs showed that students perceived AIDT as a convenient tool that supports language learning, enhances engagement, and facilitates personalized learning. Nonetheless, unmet needs included operational complexity, login difficulties, and system instability, alongside additional needs for enhanced learning support, gamification, expanded language-learning support, improved usability, and more advanced personalized functions. These findings reveal a critical gap between AIDT’s pedagogical potential and its current classroom realization, calling for deliberate improvements in system usability, instructional integration, and personalized support.

abstract_ko: Purpose The purpose of this study is to understand teachers' perceptions of the use of AI in Korean language education. Korea's Ministry of Education announced the introduction of AI digital textbooks starting in 2025. The transition to AI digital textbooks will drive changes in Korean language education. However, if teachers' perceptions are not taken into consideration, AI digital textbooks cannot be used meaningfully. In particular, among the functions of AI digital textbooks, AI tutors and AI assistant teachers are noteworthy in that they enable people to recognize AI as the subject of communication. Accordingly, we investigated and analyzed teachers' perceptions of the use of AI in Korean language education, focusing on AI tutors and AI assistant teachers. Method The subjects of the study were elementary and middle and high school teachers who were interested in the Korean language subject, taking into account the diversity of the region. First, responses to digital textbooks, AI assistant teachers, and AI tutors were collected in the form of a free response question. Based on the response results, in-depth interviews were conducted with each individual. A literature search was conducted in parallel to provide an in-depth understanding of the questionnaires and interviews that the research participants responded to. In addition, a three-member consultative body was formed to verify the analysis and ensure universal research validity.
